description_en: Restores backup data of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance to an existing instance or a new instance
description_zh: 该接口用于将RDS SQL Server备份数据恢复到已有实例或新实例上
name: RecoveryDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the new instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The storage capacity of the new instance. Unit: GB. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html.

You must set this parameter to a value that is greater than or equal to the storage capacity of the original instance
parameters.help_zh:
新实例存储容量。单位：GB。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html。

新实例的磁盘空间不能小于原实例的磁盘空间
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the new instance. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
新实例付费类型：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the new instance. Valid values:

Classic
VPC

By default, the new instance uses the same network type as the original instance
parameters.help_zh:
新实例网络类型：
Classic：经典网络
VPC：专有网络

默认与原实例网络类型一致
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the original instance.

If you specify BackupId, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If you specify RestoreTime, you must also specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
原实例ID。

按备份集恢复（即指定BackupId参数）时，本参数不是必须项。
按时间点恢复（即指定RestoreTime参数）时，本参数为必须项
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination instance
parameters.name: target_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. When you restore data to a new instance, the format of the database name is `Original database name 1,New database name 2`.

For more information about how to restore data to an existing instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628854.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称，恢复数据至新实例时格式为：`原库名1,新库名2`。

如需恢复到已有实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628854.html
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en:
The backup set ID. You can call the DescribeBackups operation to query the backup set ID.

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify DBInstanceId.

You must specify at least one of the BackupId or RestoreTime parameters
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID，可通过查询备份列表接口DescribeBackups获取。

指定此参数时，DBInstanceId参数为可选。

BackupId和RestoreTime两者至少传入一个
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The point in time to which you want to restore data. The point in time must fall within the specified log backup retention period. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DBInstanceId.

You must specify at least one of BackupId and RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh: 备份保留周期内的任意时间点。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 指定此参数时，DBInstanceId参数为必须。 BackupId和RestoreTime两者至少传入一个
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the new instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the new instance. If you specify more than one vSwitch ID, you must separate the IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 新实例虚拟交换机ID，多个值用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The internal IP address of the new instance. The internal IP address must be within the CIDR block that is supported by the specified vSwitch. The system automatically assigns an internal IP address based on the values of the VPCId and VSwitchId parameters
parameters.help_zh: 设置新实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过VPCId和VSwitchId自动分配
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

Valid values when Period is set to Year: 1 to 3.****
Valid values when Period is set to Month: 1 to 9.****

This parameter must be specified when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定新实例购买时长，取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~3。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~9。

若付费类型为Prepaid则该参数必须传入
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The unit that is used to calculate the billing cycle of the new instance. This parameter takes effect only when you select the subscription billing method for the new instance. Valid values:

Year
Month

This parameter must be specified when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定新的预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月

若参数PayType=Prepaid，该参数必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the new instance. Valid values:

local_ssd/ephemeral_ssd: local SSD
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: enhanced SSD (ESSD)
parameters.help_zh:
新实例存储类型，取值：
local_ssd/ephemeral_ssd：本地SSD盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type
